title: BAGSMART launches Blast X travel bags
summary: BAGSMART announced November 13 availability for Blast X: a 38 L travel backpack, a 38 L limited edition with a Starlight grid front panel, and a 43 L rolling backpack. The brand quotes a US collection range of USD 119.99–229.99. On November 15 the Atlas verified the 43 L roller at USD 229.99 in Black, Ivory, Smoky Blue and Brick, with exterior and interior photographs for each.

sources.label: US 43 L roller product page · checked November 15

title: Samsonite reports Q3 2026 results
summary: For July–September 2026, worldwide group net sales were USD 872.7 million, flat year over year in reported dollars and up 0.6% at constant currency. Travel-category revenue was USD 555.6 million, down 1.1% reported and 0.5% at constant currency. These are company/category revenues, not unit sales, retailer rankings or model popularity.

title: RIMOWA and Maison Margiela announce Classic Cabin
summary: The hand-painted Classic Cabin has a white lining with exposed stitching. RIMOWA quotes EUR 3,200 for the case and EUR 3,600 for the separate 5AC XL bag. Selected stores and both brands’ websites are scheduled to begin sales November 19.

title: RIMOWA extends wheel and handle customization to Original
summary: RIMOWA dates worldwide availability to November 4. The EUR 135 wheel sets use a T20 screwdriver. D50 fits Original Compact, Pilot and Cabin sizes. D65 fits Original Check-in and Trunk. The EUR 250 handle set for Original Silver Cabin, Check-in and Trunk requires specialist installation in store.

title: Nordstrom lists American Dreamliner Navy carry-on at USD 42.49
summary: Nordstrom shows USD 42.49 and a previous price of USD 49.99 for one Navy 22.5-inch carry-on. Concept One Accessories is the marketplace seller. Launch date and promotion period are unverified.

title: BAGSMART Getaway carry-on listed at USD 127.99
summary: The US storefront displayed USD 127.99 for 12 saved 20-inch Getaway color variants on November 16. Their November 8 observation was USD 143.99. Promotion start and end dates are unknown.
